features.description: Initialize a coherent Muntin Mojo project for the verified stable toolchain and record the exact toolchain version.
acceptance: Project layout is valid for the verified stable Mojo toolchain.
The exact Mojo version used for verification is recorded in project documentation or canonical check output.
A clean repository user can discover the canonical verification commands from README/docs.
evidence: pixi run --frozen mojo --version -> 'Mojo 1.1.0 (8189361e)' (pixi 0.81.0); pixi.lock pins mojo-1.1.0 and mojo-compiler-1.1.0 for osx-arm64 and linux-64.
./scripts/check.sh -> exit 0; 'toolchain' step prints 'Mojo 1.1.0 (8189361e)' and fails on any other version; 'build package' step: mojo precompile --Werror src/muntin -> ok.
README.md 'Development' section lists ./scripts/check.sh, ./scripts/test.sh and git diff --check plus the Mojo version.

features.description: Provide reliable canonical check and test scripts.
acceptance: scripts/check.sh exists, is executable, and returns nonzero on relevant build/static failures.
scripts/test.sh exists, is executable, and runs executable Muntin tests.
Both scripts exit 0 on the verified M0 implementation.
evidence: ./scripts/check.sh -> exit 0 (toolchain, format, architecture boundary, build package, build tests --Werror, build example).
./scripts/test.sh -> exit 0 (tests/test_app.mojo: 'Summary ... 6 tests run: 6 passed , 0 failed , 0 skipped').

Negative (planted then reverted): type error in src/muntin/http.mojo -> check.sh exit 1 at 'build package' ('cannot implicitly convert StringLiteral["x"] value to Int'); misformatted function -> check.sh exit 1 at 'format'; 'from flare.http import Request as FlareRequest' in app.mojo -> check.sh exit 1 at 'architecture boundary'; unused variable in a test -> check.sh exit 1 at 'build tests'.
Negative (planted then reverted): router condition replaced with 'if True:' -> test.sh exit 1 (3 FAIL); test file whose main() never runs TestSuite -> test.sh exit 1 ('ran no tests').

features.description: Implement the minimal Muntin-owned application contracts for request dispatch.
acceptance: Muntin owns the application entry point and Request/Response contracts or documented proven equivalents.
A handler can be registered and dispatched for a static GET route.
Muntin core/public modules do not import Flare.
evidence: src/muntin/{__init__,http,app}.mojo define Muntin-owned App, Request, Response; App.get[path](handler) registers a static GET route; App.handle(Request) -> Response dispatches.
./scripts/test.sh -> PASS test_get_hello_through_backend_seam (app.handle(Request("GET", "/hello")) -> 200 'hello').
./scripts/check_boundaries.sh (run by check.sh) -> 'ok: no Flare/socket imports in src/muntin'; planted Flare import and 'muntin_flare_adapter' identifier each -> exit 1.

features.description: Prove GET /hello returns status 200 and body hello through real Muntin routing/application dispatch.
acceptance: An executable test sends a GET /hello request through Muntin's application dispatch path.
The observed response status is 200.
The observed response body is hello.
The test does not bypass routing by calling the hello handler directly.
evidence: ./scripts/test.sh -> PASS test_get_hello_through_test_client (TestClient(app).get("/hello") -> status 200, text 'hello'), test_get_hello_through_backend_seam, test_router_selects_matching_route, test_unregistered_path_is_not_found, test_method_mismatch_is_not_found; 6 tests run: 6 passed.

Tests never call hello() directly; mutation 'if True:' in App.handle route matching -> 3 tests FAIL, test.sh exit 1. Independent reviewer mutations (ignore path, ignore method, 404->200, TestClient hardcoding 'hello') were each caught.

features.description: Prove transport replaceability with an in-memory/reference backend or TestClient.
acceptance: The application can be driven without opening a real network socket.
The same Muntin application seam intended for real backend adapters is exercised.
No public application API exposes or requires Flare types.
evidence: ./scripts/test.sh -> PASS test_get_hello_through_test_client: muntin.testing.TestClient builds a Muntin Request and calls App.handle, the documented backend seam (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 'Implemented M0 layout').
src/muntin/testing.mojo imports only .app and .http; check_boundaries.sh -> 'ok: no Flare/socket imports in src/muntin'.
Public exports (src/muntin/__init__.mojo): App, Request, Response only; none reference Flare.

features.description: Keep the M0 public surface compatible with Muntin's canonical DX direction without inventing unsupported Mojo syntax.
acceptance: The checked-in Hello World example/test uses only Muntin-owned application concepts.
Any deviation from a docs/DX.md target syntax caused by Mojo is documented with toolchain/compiler evidence.
M0 does not expose backend/runtime machinery merely to register an ordinary route.
evidence: main.mojo (Hello World) uses only muntin.App and muntin.testing.TestClient; check.sh 'build example' -> ok; ./build/muntin prints '200 hello'.
app.get["/hello"](hello), TestClient(app), client.get, response.status, response.text() and Response.text("ok", status=201) compile and run as in docs/DX.md (tests/test_app.mojo).

Mojo 1.1.0 limitation recorded in docs/DX.md 'Proven vs. target status': storing 'def() -> String' in a struct field -> "error: struct fields do not support trait types; 'def() -> String' is a trait"; Muntin stores 'def() thin -> String' internally, application handlers unchanged.
Registering a route requires no backend/runtime type: App.get takes only a route literal and a handler.

features.description: Finish M0 with accurate architecture, DX, and handoff state.
acceptance: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md matches the implemented dependency direction.
docs/DX.md clearly distinguishes proven syntax from future target syntax.
AGENT_PROGRESS.md records successful verification and the next work item.
git diff --check succeeds.
evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 'Implemented M0 layout' documents App.handle as the seam, testing -> app -> http dependency direction and the boundary check; docs/DX.md 'Proven vs. target status' separates proven from target syntax.
AGENT_PROGRESS.md records verification commands, decisions, limitations and next step (M1-001).
git add -A && git diff --cached --check -> exit 0.

features.description: Prove that one Muntin app can store and dispatch String-returning, Int-path-parameter, and raw Request -> Response handlers with the docs/DX.md registration shape, and record the internal representation trade-off.
acceptance: An executable test registers def() -> String, def(Int) -> User, and def(Request) -> Response handlers in one app and dispatches each through handle(Request) -> Response.
GET /users/{id} delivers the path segment to the handler as Int.
At least two internal representations are compared and the trade-off and recommendation are recorded in docs/DX.md.
Whether a route/handler mismatch fails at compile time is demonstrated with compiler output.
The spike adds no Flare dependency and does not change the M0 public API in src/muntin.
evidence: ./scripts/test.sh -> exit 0; tests/test_spike_handler_model.mojo: PASS test_runtime_value_app_dispatches_three_shapes, PASS test_compile_time_app_dispatches_three_shapes (2 tests run: 2 passed). Each registers root() -> String at GET /, get_user(id: Int) -> User at GET /users/{id}, raw(req: Request) -> Response at POST /raw, and asserts via handle(Request): '/' -> 'hello', '/users/42' -> 'User(42, Alice)', POST /raw 'ping' -> 201 'raw:ping', '/users/abc' -> 400, GET /raw -> 404.
Mutation: _match treating {id} segments as literals -> both spike tests FAIL (2 failed).

Compile-time mismatch: planting app.get["/users/{id}"](root) (runtime prototype) and app.get["/users/{id}", root]() (compile-time prototype) each fails to compile with 'note: constraint failed: route declares path parameters but the handler takes none', with a note pointing at the registration call. app.post["/raw"](root) fails with "cannot be converted from 'def root() thin -> String' to 'def(Request) thin -> Response'".
docs/DX.md 'Handler model (M0.5 spike)' compares runtime-value erasure vs compile-time handler parameter and recommends the runtime-value design with the compile-time one as fallback.
./scripts/check.sh -> exit 0 (boundary ok: no Flare/socket imports in src/muntin; tests build with --Werror); git diff --stat shows no change under src/muntin.

features.description: Pin and document a released Flare version compatible with the verified Mojo toolchain.
acceptance: Flare dependency uses a released tag or other reproducible immutable reference.
Verified Mojo and Flare versions are recorded.
Core/public Muntin modules remain buildable without importing Flare.

features.description: Implement the Flare adapter behind the existing Muntin backend seam.
acceptance: Adapter depends inward on Muntin application contracts.
No application handler signature requires a Flare type.
Adapter contract tests pass.

features.description: Prove a real localhost HTTP round trip through Flare and Muntin.
acceptance: A real local HTTP request enters through Flare, crosses the Muntin adapter, dispatches a Muntin route, and returns the expected response.
The equivalent application behavior still passes through the in-memory backend.
All M0 checks remain passing without weakening their intent.

features.description: Deliver one path parameter to a handler as Int without manual application parsing.
acceptance: The public syntax is proven to compile on the supported Mojo version and documented in docs/DX.md.
GET /users/42 yields handler input Int(42).
Invalid integer input produces documented client-error behavior.
The same handler signature works with in-memory and any enabled real backend.
